crossRefs.note: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.

people.name: Appaim
people.line: Son of Nadab, descendant of Judah

people.name: Ishi
people.line: Son of Appaim, descendant of Judah.

people.name: Sheshan
people.line: Jerahmeelite whose daughter married his Egyptian servant
